title: Chocolate candy, caramel filled with nuts

content.title: About
content.content: Chocolate candy with caramel filling and nuts are small sweets coated in milk or dark chocolate, with a soft caramel center that contains pieces of nuts (commonly hazelnut, almond or cashew). They combine a crunchy nut texture, sweet caramel and a rich chocolate flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The caramel is often made from butter and sugar, giving it a silky consistency.
Nuts in the filling are usually toasted to enhance their aroma.
These candies are popular in Europe and the United States as festive gifts.
Some recipes add a pinch of sea salt, creating a sweet‑salty contrast.
The first versions appeared in early 20th‑century French confectioneries.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Nuts provide monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Chocolate, especially dark, contains flavonoids that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Nuts and caramel syrup supply magnesium, iron and zinc, important for metabolism.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: The combination of sugar and fats rapidly replenishes energy, making it a handy snack.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Chocolate stimulates serotonin and endorphin production, improving mood.

items.title: Tree nut allergy
items.content: The candies contain nuts, which can trigger severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Caramel and chocolate make the product calorie‑dense and increase the risk of tooth decay with frequent consumption.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: One candy can contain 50–80 kcal; portion control is recommended.

items.title: Possible trans fats
items.content: Some manufacturers use partially hydrogenated oils in the caramel; choose versions without trans fats.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the candies as a standalone sweet snack, add them to dessert mixes, use in baking, or as a garnish for ice cream. Slightly warming them makes the caramel more fluid for drizzling.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the candies in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer shelf life keep them refrigerated to prevent the chocolate from melting. Keep them away from strong odors.
